## Summary

Prose that is not a criterion, and names no check.

## Acceptance criteria

* **AC1 — the 1th thing the change must do.** Prose restating it at length so the item is not a bare label.
* **AC2 — the 2th thing the change must do.** Prose restating it at length so the item is not a bare label.
* **AC3 — the 3th thing the change must do.** Prose restating it at length so the item is not a bare label.

## Out of scope

Judging whether the bound check proves the criterion.
